skills.name: arma-reforger-game-data
skills.description: Read Arma Reforger game data out of the .pak archives and the EBIN worlds inside them - the entry tree, extracted .conf and .c sources, world .ent files with their entities and bases, resource GUIDs, the localization string tables behind `#AR-...` keys, and content searches. Use when a .pak read fails with "incorrect header check", "unknown compression method" or Z_DATA_ERROR, when an extracted file looks cyclically shifted or has another file's bytes at the end, when a world .ent file looks like binary, when you need the GUID for a scenario/world/prefab to put in a config, when you need vanilla script or config text to override, or when a value like `#AR-Campaign_MapLocation_Cain_Kamensk` needs the text a player sees - or a string table reports more texts than ids. Also use before writing any new pak-, .ent- or string-table-parsing code - both formats and the one mistake that breaks pak reads are documented here.

skills.name: arma-reforger-rcon
skills.description: Configure, secure and operate the Arma Reforger dedicated server RCON - the rcon block in server.json, the BattlEye RCon v2 packet format it turned out to speak, the two independent permission systems (ERCONPermissions for RCON and EPlayerRole for chat), the full # command list with the exact answers the server returns, and log-based diagnostics. Ships tools/rcon.mjs, the client to use instead of writing one. Use when enabling RCON or debugging why it refuses to start, when choosing between monitor and admin, when a command works over RCON but not in game chat, when BERCon.exe is mistaken for the Bohemia RCON, when writing or debugging an RCON client, when banning or unbanning a player, when bans hang in PENDING or time out, or when a killed client keeps a maxClients slot busy.

skills.name: arma-reforger-server-config
skills.description: Author or fix an Arma Reforger dedicated server config (server.json / config.json) - the top-level keys, gameProperties, mods, operating, the missionHeader override block, and how to launch the server on Windows or Linux so it actually reads the config. Use when asked to create, edit, review, or debug a server config; when a server refuses to start or the log shows "JSON is invalid!", "additionalProperties error", "There are errors in server config!", "JSON parse error" or "Failed to load server config!" (older notes and the wiki quote "Server Config file is Invalid" instead, which the server does not actually write); when it shows a "Missing Addon" dialog with the GUID 58D0FB3206B6F859; when setting up a Linux server with SteamCMD or systemd; when a missionHeader key seems to have no effect; or when choosing a scenarioId. Not for client-side settings or for Workbench project files.

skills.name: arma-reforger-server-launch
skills.description: Launch an Arma Reforger dedicated server on the user's machine or on a remote one over SSH and prove it is up - ask where it should run, check the target for the server and Node.js, install what is missing with the package manager and SteamCMD (or in Steam), copy tools/ to the target, interview for the settings that matter (public address, RCON, profile and ownerToken, admins, cross-platform, max players, scenario, folder), write and validate server.json, place it next to the executable with a start script, launch outside any sandbox with the working directory set to the server directory, watch the log until "Server registered with address:", check the UDP ports and the A2S answer, then hand over the join code, the port-forwarding rules and the NAT-hairpin warning. Use when asked to set up, launch, start or move a server; when the server or tools are missing on the machine; when the log shows "Missing Addon" / "Can't find '58D0FB3206B6F859' game addon"; when the server never appears in the browser or never registers; when a port looks closed or RCON does not answer.
